supersedes: selector-contract-r21.json provenance representation; five outcomes unchanged

decisions.rationale: Git defines an existing commit as commit-ish; lane ancestry applies, and pushed means ancestor of the local origin tracking ref only when that ref exists.
Any tree is not commit-ish; the measured control uses a non-empty tree. The lane policy supplies the refusal code.
A blob is not commit-ish; the lane policy supplies the refusal code.
Annotated tags including nested annotated tags peel recursively to a commit; lane ancestry applies, and the origin tracking ref is checked only when present.
An annotated tag ending at tree or blob cannot peel to the requested commit type; the lane supplies the refusal code. The finite consumer matrix covers single-level noncommit targets only.
